{{Top|leg}}
A '''Blast tube''' was a weapon used by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] assassination teams, as well as [[Drend Navett]]'s [[Vengeance (organization)|Vengeance]] cell. It was used with a [[Redirection crystal/Legends|redirection crystal]] to make it look like someone had fired a shot when the shooter hit the crystal behind them, making it looks like a blast.
